oadby.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Leicestershire
s1loc: Oadby has reached strong full-fibre coverage on the back of a busy Leicester build. Openreach has invested heavily in fibre to the premises across the Leicester exchange area, CityFibre has pushed its independent gigabit network out from the city into Oadby and the LE2 districts, and Virgin Media keeps upgrading its cable footprint alongside. Between the three networks there is steady work for civils gangs, jointers and fibre engineers through Oadby itself, neighbouring Wigston and South Wigston, and the residential streets around Brocks Hill and the Leicester Racecourse edge of the town.

The commercial scene runs on the borough's employment land and its biggest neighbour. Kenilworth Drive off the B582 carries over a hundred businesses in engineering and food production, while Wigston Business Park, Genesis Park and the Chartwell Drive and Viking Road estates host warehousing, offices and light manufacturing from names like Cromwell Tools and Pladis. The University of Leicester, whose main campus and halls sit in Oadby, adds further network demand. All of it needs structured cabling in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre plus CCTV and access control, wired by local installers across commercial premises and homes alike.
